'''Spencer Norman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2001 Buford tournament]] on 24 November 2001 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|HB flip/mains?]], according to Will Gilchrist's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3117">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-24-buford-georgia-11-24-01d3117/ buford-georgia-11-24-01], DeckTech (will "Magmaniac" gilchrist, 24 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-24-buford-georgia-11-24-01d3117/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
